as_told.title: FBI document on the UFO-nuclear connection

plain: In 1949, according to Jesse Michels, an FBI memo went to the bureau's director, J. Edgar Hoover, reporting "flying discs", "flying saucers" and "balls of fire" around Los Alamos, New Mexico, things "considered top secret by intelligence officers of both the Army and Air Force." Michels tells it himself, calling the memo now public, and on a later show he points to the same FBI document, without naming Hoover, as evidence of a link between UFOs and nuclear sites.
